title: Cross-Prompt Reuse of Entity-Replacement Responses
abstract: arXiv:2611.00352v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With model weights fixed, we measure how much of an entity-replacement response transfers between English factual questions, beyond whether answers change. We add the hidden-state change from two source questions to a target question about the same entity, comparing the predicted log-probability shift between two relations' published answers, given known answer prefixes, with the measured one. Hidden reuse injects the aligned change at 50% depth before the target's remaining layers; direct reuse adds source output-score changes. With other-relation sources, hidden reuse removes 45% and 49% of no-change error on 0.5-1B Qwen and Llama. Gemma-2-2B removes 22% and passes one of three comparisons in plain text without its default beginning-of-sequence (BOS) token. A later protocol restoring it yields 58-68%, passing every comparison on three cohorts. Larger checkpoints, chat format and new entities show replication and format- or cohort-depen

translated_title: 跨提示的实体替换响应复用
translated_abstract: 在模型权重固定的情况下，我们测量了实体替换响应在英文事实性问题之间的迁移程度，而不仅仅是答案是否改变。我们将来自两个源问题的隐状态变化添加到关于同一实体的目标问题上，并在给定已知答案前缀的条件下，将两种关系的已发布答案之间预测的对数概率偏移与实际测量到的偏移进行比较。隐式复用在目标模型剩余层之前50%的深度处注入对齐的变化；直接复用则叠加源问题的输出分数变化。在使用其他关系作为源时，隐式复用在0.5-1B参数的Qwen和Llama模型上分别消除了45%和49%的无变化误差。Gemma-2-2B在纯文本输入且不使用其默认序列开始（BOS）标记的情况下消除了22%的误差，并通过了三个比较中的一个。后续恢复BOS标记的协议取得了58%-68%的结果，在三个模型队列上通过了所有比较。更大的模型检查点、聊天格式和新实体的实验显示了复现性以及格式或队列依赖性。
tldr: 该论文发现在固定模型权重的前提下，将源问题引发的隐状态变化注入目标问题的中间层，可以实现实体替换响应在事实性问题之间的跨提示复用，在Qwen、Llama和Gemma等小型语言模型上最多消除约一半的无变化误差。
en_tdlr: With model weights fixed, injecting hidden-state changes from source questions into the intermediate layers of a target question enables cross-prompt reuse of entity-replacement responses, removing up to about half of the no-change error across small Qwen, Llama, and Gemma models.
